column1: # Expected non-clean outcomes for the print book's Bynk snippet projects.
# Any project NOT listed here must `bynkc check` cleanly (a valid program).
# The "fail" rows are the deliberately-rejected listings whose refusal is the
# evidence a chapter discusses; the code must match what that chapter quotes.
# refusal is specific to `compile --platform node` and is exercised separately.
# Since 0.403.3 the schema registry is consulted by `check`, so the retyped
# event is an ordinary `fail` row. The `build-fail` kind (check passes, the
# build refuses; scripts/check-book-emit.sh asserts it) has no row now.
# bynk.transition.may_violate (0.403.3) warns where a handler can move an agent
# through a step its `transition` refuses at commit. Chapters 6 and 12 build on
# exactly such handlers, so the warning is expected.
